subject: {ad_soyad} – Volunteer Internship Request
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

My name is {ad_soyad}, and I am currently a student of {bolum} at {okul}. I would like to ask whether it would be possible to complete a voluntary (unpaid) internship in {meslek} at {sirket_adi}. I would be happy to discuss a suitable date range. Please find my CV attached.

Best regards,
{ad_soyad}
